recommended_action: Design a real-CDN or CDN-simulator experiment to test decompression-normalization where compression is non-deterministic. This is the single highest-information question remaining for C-MEAS-VALID. Requires different infrastructure (Cloudflare Workers, Fastly Compute, or a CDN simulator with per-request quality negotiation and caching). If algorithm-equivalence and discrimination survive real-CDN, the claim ceiling advances materially toward product readiness. If they fail, the design space narrows to synthetic-only deployment. Also fix hash()-based seed derivation to use deterministic hashlib before any re-run of the current synthetic experiment.
